result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: the partially visible category chip and restaurant card at the right edge are expected horizontal-carousel behavior, and the pizza card cut off at the bottom is normal vertical scroll behavior. One genuine visual defect remains: the OS home indicator bar overlaps the bottom navigation icons.

issues.description: The device home indicator (horizontal gesture bar) is rendered on top of the bottom tab bar, crossing through the search and orders/bookmarks icons and obscuring them.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom inset/padding to the tab bar so the navigation icons sit above the home indicator instead of being overlapped by it.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the restaurant cards are icon-only dark circles with no visible label, which is unclear for screen-reader and first-time users.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessibility label (e.g. 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites') and consider a subtle visible affordance or tooltip.
